title: College Shadowing Initative
briefDesc: Across the country there are many high school students who are not sure what their college major actually entails, or what major they should pick. Seeking to provide advice to high schools in this position, I am currently working with a team of scholars at my university to create a shadowing program for high school students. This shadowing program will allow students to actually see what a day looks like in college, while also getting more insight into what their planned major entails.

title: Local Cleanup Effort
briefDesc: Currently, in my area a local park has an entrance that is over-grown and poorly maintained. Working with a team, my group organized excavation units and volunteers to help clean up the area. After clean-up, new plants were brought in and planted by the community to make the park easily accessible for local residents and tourists.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
briefDesc: As part of a funded resarch opportunity at my university, I worked on proposing and developing solutions to make large langauge models generate code more efficiently. Using a GPU cluster, over 80,000 Python files were parsed into abstract syntax trees to use as training material for an LLM. Leveraging the predictable structure of abstract syntax trees in programs, LLM token fertility was decreased by 61%.

title: Littering Initative
briefDesc: As part of a community service program at my unviersity, we developed a littering initative that sought to engage highschoolers in local issues. High schoolers were guided through a reesarch project on a local littering issue, and developed proposals on how the issue could be fixed or mitigated in the future. These proposals were then formally presented at a research forum, giving the students real experience on researching and solving issues in their area.
